E;  AND WHOSE CORDIAL SYMPATHY AND REGARD,  WITH FRANKEST RECOGNITION OF HIS  DEEP DEVOTION TO HIS ART,  GAVE ONE OF ITS FEW GREAT PLEASURES TO THE  SHORT LIFE OF  A DEAR BROTHER OF MINE,  THIS BOOK  IS HUMBLY DEDICATED,  WITH GRATEFUL RECOLLECTIONS OF THE PAST_.

56584-daily-training.title: _Daily Training_
56584-daily-training.creator: E. F. Benson
56584-daily-training.description: A book by E. F. Benson. One again is seldom seen without some appliance of tobacco in his mouth, because he finds it agreeable and after an experiment of abstinence from it found that it did not make any difference, as far as he could make out, in his general health. The other never smokes at all. One again takes a cold bath in the morning, the other a hot one followed by cold sponging.

arxiv-2011-10790.title: Convexity and transport for isentropic Euler equations on a sphere
arxiv-2011-10790.creator: Gordon Blower
arxiv-2011-10790.description: Abstract . The paper considers the Euler system of PDE on a smooth compact Riemannian manifold of positive curvature without boundary, and the sphere 𝕊 2 {\mathbb{S}}^{2} in particular. The paper interprets the Euler equations as a transport problem for the fluid density under dynamics governed by the gradient of the internal energy of the fluid.

arxiv-2011-11322.title: Transition to synchrony in chiral active particles
arxiv-2011-11322.creator: Arkady Pikovsky
arxiv-2011-11322.description: Abstract I study deterministic dynamics of chiral active particles in two dimensions. Particles are considered as discs interacting with elastic repulsive forces. An ensemble of particles, started from random initial conditions, demonstrates chaotic collisions resulting in their normal diffusion. This chaos is transient, as rather abruptly a synchronous collisionless state establishes.

arxiv-2109-10288.title: Electric Penrose process: high-energy acceleration of ionized particles by non-rotating weakly charged black hole
arxiv-2109-10288.creator: Arman Tursunov, Bakhtinur Juraev, Zdeněk Stuchlík, Martin Kološ
arxiv-2109-10288.description: Abstract In many astrophysical scenarios the charge of the black hole is often neglected due to unrealistically large values of the charge required for the Reissner-Nordström spacetime metric. However, black holes may possess small electric charge due to various selective accretion mechanisms.

arxiv-2406-12730.title: Predicting the energetic proton flux with a machine learning regression algorithm
arxiv-2406-12730.creator: Mirko Stumpo, Monica Laurenza, Simone Benella, Maria Federica Marcucci
arxiv-2406-12730.description: Abstract The need of real-time of monitoring and alerting systems for Space Weather hazards has grown significantly in the last two decades. One of the most important challenge for space mission operations and planning is the prediction of solar proton events (SPEs).

arxiv-2407-13578.title: How Reliable are LLMs as Knowledge Bases? Re-thinking Facutality and Consistency
arxiv-2407-13578.creator: Danna Zheng, Mirella Lapata, Jeff Z. Pan
arxiv-2407-13578.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Danna Zheng, Mirella Lapata, Jeff Z. Pan. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly explored as knowledge bases (KBs), yet current evaluation methods focus too narrowly on knowledge retention, overlooking other crucial criteria for reliable performance. In this work, we rethink the requirements for evaluating reliable LLM-as-KB usage and highlight two essential factors: factuality, ensuring accurate responses to seen and unseen knowledge 1 1 1 Seen knowledge refers to knowledge learned during training.

arxiv-2411-10251.title: Morpho-Aware Global Attention for Image Matting
arxiv-2411-10251.creator: Jingru Yang, Chengzhi Cao, Chentianye Xu, Zhongwei Xie, Kaixiang Huang, Yang Zhou, Shengfeng He
arxiv-2411-10251.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jingru Yang, Chengzhi Cao, Chentianye Xu, Zhongwei Xie, Kaixiang Huang, Yang Zhou, Shengfeng He. Vision Transformers (ViTs) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) both face challenges in image matting, especially in preserving fine structural details. ViTs, with their global receptive field in the self-attention mechanism, often lose local details, such as hair, while CNNs, limited by their local receptive field, require deeper layers to approximate global context—yet still struggle with retaining fine structures in deeper architectures.

arxiv-2412-14292.title: Schottky invariant diffusion on the transcendent p p -adic upper half plane
arxiv-2412-14292.creator: Patrick Erik Bradley
arxiv-2412-14292.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Patrick Erik Bradley. The transcendent part of the Drinfel’d p p -adic upper half plane is shown to be a Polish space. Using Radon measures associated with regular differential 1 1 -forms invariant under Schottky groups allows to construct self-adjoint diffusion operators as Laplacian integral operators with kernel functions determined by the p p -adic absolute value on the complex p p -adic numbers.

arxiv-2501-10460.title: A Generalized Benford Framework for Threat Identification in Counter-Intelligence
arxiv-2501-10460.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . In this paper, we develop a framework of ‘Benford models’ for counter-intelligence investigations which analyze frequency data of a suspect’s visits to physical locations, online websites, and communication channels. We accomplish this by establishing the Benford measure for continuous & bounded domains, generalizing the accumulated percentage differences between sites in the frequency data with the log-determinant of ‘Benford Matrices,’ employing an estimator to determine a ‘Benford Test Statistic ( λ \lambda ),’ and identifying maximal values of λ \lambda across all permutations of

arxiv-2505-13722.title: Practice Makes Perfect: A Study of Digital Twin Technology for Assembly and Problem-solving using Lunar Surface Telerobotics Journal: Advances in Space Research
arxiv-2505-13722.creator: Xavier O’Keefe, Katy McCutchan, Alexis Muniz, Jack Burns, Daniel Szafir
arxiv-2505-13722.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xavier O’Keefe, Katy McCutchan, Alexis Muniz, Jack Burns, Daniel Szafir. Robotic systems that can traverse planetary or lunar surfaces to collect environmental data and perform physical manipulation tasks, such as assembling equipment or conducting mining operations, are envisioned to form the backbone of future human activities in space. However, the environmental conditions in which these robots, or “rovers,” operate present challenges towards achieving fully autonomous solutions, meaning that rover missions will require some degree of human teleoperation or supervision for the foreseeable future.

arxiv-2509-20492.title: Quantum non-Gaussianity based on amplified photon statistics
arxiv-2509-20492.creator: Éva Rácz, László Ruppert, Radim Filip
arxiv-2509-20492.description: Abstract Amplification is an essential part of quantum processing and detection that allows for reducing subsequent loss and noise. However, the intensive amplification transfers individual discrete quanta to a detected continuous signal, so Fock probabilities of the unknown input state are not readily available.

arxiv-2512-18925.title: An Empirical Study of Developer-Provided Context for AI Coding Assistants in Open-Source Projects DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation email; June 03–05, 2025; Woodstock, NY ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2025/06 CCS: Software and it
arxiv-2512-18925.creator: Shaokang Jiang, Daye Nam
arxiv-2512-18925.description: Abstract . While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, research shows that their effectiveness depends not only on explicit prompts but also on the broader context provided. This requirement is especially pronounced in software engineering, where the goals, architecture, and collaborative conventions of an existing project play critical roles in response quality.

arxiv-2512-19957.title: Zero-Shot Segmentation through Prototype-Guidance for Multi-Label Plant Species Identification
arxiv-2512-19957.creator: Luciano Araujo Dourado Filho, Almir Moreira da Silva Neto, Rodrigo Pereira David, Rodrigo Tripodi Calumby
arxiv-2512-19957.description: Abstract This paper presents an approach developed to address the PlantClef 2025 challenge, which consists of a fine-grained multi-label species identification, over high-resolution images. Our solution focused on employing class prototypes obtained from the training dataset as a proxy guidance for training a segmentation Vision Transformer (ViT) on the test set images.

arxiv-2602-18781.creator: Pavan Adroja, Sanjay Amrutiya, Riddhi Patil
arxiv-2602-18781.description: Abstract . We develop a theory of smooth relative connections over the real path algebra ℝ ​ Q \mathbb{R}Q on smooth twisted quiver bundles. We give obstructions to the existence of a smooth relative connection on twisted quiver bundles. For tree-type quiver bundles, we establish a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of a smooth relative connection.

pmc-10607541.title: High-Flow Oxygen Therapy in the Perioperative Setting and Procedural Sedation: A Review of Current Evidence
pmc-10607541.creator: Lou’i Al-Husinat, Basil Jouryyeh, Ahlam Rawashdeh, Abdelrahman Alenaizat, Mohammad Abushehab, Mohammad Wasfi Amir, Zaid Al Modanat, Denise Battaglini, Gilda Cinnella
pmc-10607541.description: High-flow oxygen therapy (HFOT) is a respiratory support system, through which high flows of humidified and heated gas are delivered to hypoxemic patients. Several mechanisms explain how HFOT improves arterial blood gases and enhances patients’ comfort. Some mechanisms are well understood, but others are still unclear and under investigation.

pmc-10618192.title: Lactate as a major epigenetic carbon source for histone acetylation via nuclear LDH metabolism
pmc-10618192.creator: Yong Jin An, Sihyang Jo, Jin-Mo Kim, Han Sun Kim, Hyun Young Kim, Sang-Min Jeon, Dawool Han, Jong In Yook, Keon Wook Kang, Sunghyouk Park
pmc-10618192.description: Histone acetylation involves the transfer of two-carbon units to the nucleus that are embedded in low-concentration metabolites. We found that lactate, a high-concentration metabolic byproduct, can be a major carbon source for histone acetylation through oxidation-dependent metabolism. Both in cells and in purified nuclei, 13C3-lactate carbons are incorporated into histone H4 (maximum incorporation: ~60%).

pmc-10690725.title: Parsing Genetic and Autoimmune Etiology in Premature Ovarian Insufficiency
pmc-10690725.creator: Elise Nauwynck, Jean De Schepper, Michel De Vos, Willem Staels
pmc-10690725.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Premature ovarian insufficiency (POI) is a rare cause of primary amenorrhea in adolescents. For young women with uncertain etiology of POI, genetic and autoimmune testing may be recommended to assist in treatment and management decisions. This report presents a case of POI in a 16-year-old adolescent with both poly-autoimmune disease and a heterozygous missense variant in the bone morphogenic factor 15 (BMP15) gene, both potentially involved in the pathogenesis of POI.

pmc-11305866.title: Revealing an association between HPV and systemic lupus erythematosus: A bidirectional two‐sample Mendelian randomization study
pmc-11305866.creator: Fangfang Pan, Huiliang Shen, Ben Wang, Jian Wang
pmc-11305866.description: BackgroundAn increasing number of studies have focused on the association between Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection and systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). However, current evidence is largely based on retrospective studies, which are susceptible to confounding factors and cannot establish causation.MethodsA bidirectional two‐sample Mendelian randomization (MR) design was used to evaluate the causal relationship between HPV and SLE.

pmc-11638313.title: Mid-term outcomes of compaction autologous bone grafting in uncemented primary total hip replacement stems
pmc-11638313.creator: Satomi Abe, Masahiro Inoue, Takashi Mikami, Hidefumi Honke, Masahiro Suzuki, Taiki Kanno, Takeshi Masuda
pmc-11638313.description: IntroductionFixation and long-term stability of collared, uncemented stems, such as the CORAIL® collared stem, in total hip arthroplasty (THA), depend on a strong cancellous bone sleeve and subsequent osseointegration. This study aimed to investigate bone reaction and mid-term outcomes following compaction autologous bone grafting in uncemented stems in primary THA.

pmc-11642352.title: Current Progress in the Development of mRNA Vaccines Against Bacterial Infections
pmc-11642352.creator: Alina Khlebnikova, Anna Kirshina, Natalia Zakharova, Roman Ivanov, Vasiliy Reshetnikov
pmc-11642352.description: Bacterial infections have accompanied humanity for centuries. The discovery of the first antibiotics and the subsequent golden era of their discovery temporarily shifted the balance in this confrontation to the side of humans. Nevertheless, the excessive and improper use of antibacterial drugs and the evolution of bacteria has gotten the better of humans again.

pmc-11686943.title: Increased resilience and a regime shift reversal through repeat mass coral bleaching
pmc-11686943.creator: Nicholas A J Graham, Shaun K Wilson, Cassandra E Benkwitt, Rodney Bonne, Rodney Govinden, James P W Robinson
pmc-11686943.description: Ecosystems are substantially changing in response to ongoing climate change. For example, coral reefs have declined in coral dominance, with some reefs undergoing regime shifts to non‐coral states. However, reef responses may vary through multiple heat stress events, with the rarity of long‐term ecological datasets rendering such understanding uncertain.

pmc-11691213.title: VACCINATION MOTIVATORS AND DETERRENTS AMONG UNDERVACCINATED OLDER ADULTS IN NORTH DAKOTA
pmc-11691213.creator: Andrea Huseth-Zosel, Heather Fuller, Paul Carson
pmc-11691213.description: Despite increased risk of morbidity and mortality among older adults due to preventable infectious diseases such as influenza, shingles, pneumonia, and COVID-19, many older individuals forego receiving some, if not all, of these vaccinations. This study examines vaccination motivators and deterrents for undervaccinated older adults in North Dakota (ND).

pmc-11883249.title: Pediatric to adult rheumatology transition: Success rates, influencing factors, and evolving diagnoses and treatments
pmc-11883249.creator: Tuba Demirci Yıldırım, Rana İşgüder, Ezgi Karaçura, Yeşim Erez, Balahan Makay, Fatoş Önen, Şevket Erbil Ünsal, İsmail Sarı
pmc-11883249.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Objectives This study aimed to evaluate the rate of successful transitions, identify factors associated with early versus late transitions, and diagnosis and treatment changes after transition into adult rheumatology. Patients and methods In this retrospective study, patients with childhood-onset rheumatic diseases who transitioned from pediatric to adult rheumatology care between January 2013 and January 2023 were screened for a successful transition. Successful transitions were defined as maintaining annual visits to the adult rheumatology clinic after transition.

pmc-12482960.title: Button-related finger injuries in textile workers: the hidden danger of the industry
pmc-12482960.creator: Mehmet Şah Şakçı, Mümin Karahan
pmc-12482960.description: Objective:This study aimed to evaluate button-related injuries, which are increasingly common in the textile and apparel manufacturing sector, to contribute to diagnosis and treatment and to raise awareness among employers and workers.Methods:This retrospective study included 23 patients with button-related injuries.

pmc-12634408.title: Narrative therapy and resilience training improve recovery and survival after intersphincteric resection for low rectal cancer: a randomized trial
pmc-12634408.creator: Gang Wang, Shengjie Pan
pmc-12634408.description: BackgroundPatients undergoing intersphincteric resection (ISR) for low rectal cancer often experience persistent bowel dysfunction, psychological distress, and compromised quality of life, especially in the context of preventive stoma creation. These challenges can negatively affect recovery, immune function, and long-term prognosis.

pmc-12687990.title: Yet another report of endotracheal tube herniation through the Doughty blade of the Boyle-Davis Gag! Call for action

pmc-12718236.title: Isolation and characterization of novel phages for control of the phytopathogen Pseudomonas marginalis
pmc-12718236.creator: Dina Gamal El-Sayed, Ashraf Fathy Abd El-Rahman, El-Shaimaa Mostafa Abd El-Hamed, Marwa N Ahmed, Rasha Samir Mohamed
pmc-12718236.description: AbstractThe current study provides the first detailed characterization of two novel bacteriophages, DG23 and RG24, that infect Pseudomonas marginalis, a causative agent of soft rot in potato and other vegetable crops. The phages were assessed for environmental stability, genetic characteristics, and biocontrol efficacy.

pmc-13092973.title: rRNA expansion segments mediate ribosome dimerization as a conserved stress response
pmc-13092973.creator: Wenhong Jiang, Chen Chen, Xing Wang, Wei Huang, Dawid Krokowski, Ziyao Chen, Jiahao Xie, Zhaoming Su, Maria Hatzoglou, Derek J Taylor, Qiang Guo
pmc-13092973.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Inhibition of messenger RNA translation is a common feature in proteostatic stress cellular responses. Puromycin, a widely used compound for studying translation, disrupts protein synthesis by mimicking the 3′ end of aminoacyl–transfer RNAs. Despite its extensive use as a research tool to probe the connection between translation activity and various physiological and pathological states, the cellular response associated with puromycin-induced translation stress remains incompletely understood.

pmc-13117494.title: Tumor Thickness and Histological Grade as Determinants of Sentinel Lymph Node Metastasis in Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma
pmc-13117494.creator: Irena Janković, Goran Stevanović, Toma Kovačević, Dimitrije Janković, Dimitrije Pavlović
pmc-13117494.description: Background and Objectives: Cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) displays heterogeneous metastatic potential, and the role of sentinel lymph node biopsy (SLNB) in clinically node-negative patients remains debated. To evaluate tumor thickness and histological grade as predictors of sentinel lymph node (SLN) metastasis in high-risk cSCC and to assess the performance of a simplified pathology-based predictive model.

pmc-13474223.title: Nighttime sleep, midday napping, and mortality in Chinese older adults: A China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study longitudinal cohort study
pmc-13474223.creator: Peng Ren, Weichao Zhang, Zekun Du, Tianci Gao, Qianfei Wang, Mengxing Hou, Yaru Qiu, Fenqiao Chen, Jianqiang Mei
pmc-13474223.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the independent and combined associations of nighttime sleep duration and midday napping duration with all-cause mortality and premature death in Chinese older adults and to examine potential sex-specific differences.MethodsThis longitudinal cohort study analyzed 11,054 adults aged ≥60 years from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study 2018–2020.

pmc-13640334.title: Home-based high-intensity exercise training during neoadjuvant chemotherapy is associated with favorable chemotherapy outcomes and tumor microenvironment remodeling in breast cancer
pmc-13640334.creator: Diana Skorinkina, Kristaps Eglītis, Pawel Zayakin, Agata Mlynska, Beatriz Martin-Gracia, Eva Bassols-Citores, Lilite Sadovska, Agnese Brokāne, Fabian Rise, Krizia Sagini, Silvana Romero, Konstantinos Gkelis, Tatjana Zablocka, Mārtiņš Čampa, Rūdolfs Cešeiko, Aija Kļaviņa, Inta Liepniece-Karele, Jānis
pmc-13640334.description: BackgroundA growing number of studies show that physical exercise is feasible and safe for cancer patients and enhances various physical and cognitive capabilities, thus improving the quality of life and disease outcomes. The molecular mechanisms behind these effects are, however, poorly understood.
